allowed_operation_classes.OBSERVE_ONLY: May inspect source-indexed geometry/negative states for audit or rule evaluation diagnostics. Cannot affect candidate eligibility, weights, state, events, or RNG.
allowed_operation_classes.RULE_DECLARED_EMPIRICAL_CONSTRAINT: Owning V3 rule may use an exact deterministic predicate over pinned producer-owned PSEPF geometry to reject or retain an already-lawful candidate. It may never create a candidate, causal parent, witness, actor fact, event, state value, memory, belief, identity, or relationship.
allowed_operation_classes.RULE_DECLARED_EMPIRICAL_WEIGHT: Owning V3 rule may transform exact pinned geometry into exact rational/integer weights only under a separately versioned formula/content hash named by that rule. The already-lawful candidate set is created without PSEPF. ADP-020 alone performs any stochastic selection using those exact weights and receipts.

effective_time_rule.decision_law: Every source read must be temporally comparable under the exact producer/comparator alignment authority. Any required noncomparability yields zero effect and UPSTREAM_REQUERY or UNAVAILABLE, never interpolation/backdating.

forbidden_operations: select modal response as actor response
source majority/disagreement directly assigns actor state
use PSEPF to create candidate set or semantic eligibility absent owner rule
copy PSEPF geometry into V3 thin input
collapse source-indexed geometry or typed negatives into one pseudo-source
treat comparator receipt or replay receipt as a developmental prior
merge empirical possibility and ResolvedStructuralContext into a generic prior

UPSTREAM_REQUERY.effect: V3 cannot repair or reinterpret the field; request an exact upstream recomputation and bind its new immutable refs
when: a comparator-relevant objective actor fact changed
source applicability/effective period changed or became noncomparable
pinned PSEPF was invalidated or exact geometry cannot be dereferenced

V3_REBIND.effect: construct a new thin input binding; do not mutate PSEPF; do not rewrite history
when: same exact PSEPF refs/hashes remain producer-current and comparator snapshot remains valid
a new V3 decision invocation/use-class binding or causal-parent/intake receipt is required

owner: SCRV3_STAGE_CLOSE_CONTRACT; execution remains with each accepted V3 semantic owner
preconditions_all_required: metabolism authority ID/version/hash match the input
READ_PERMISSION_MATRIX grants the named surface/use class
the owning V3 rule version explicitly binds the same use class and exact PSEPF refs/provenance
all required source states are admissible under that owning rule without negative-state collapse
all ordinary V3 causal-parent, target-authority, scheduler and RNG requirements independently pass

exact_replay_requires: same peer ResolvedStructuralContext receipt once final seam is frozen

source_geometry_access.must_preserve: exact source-indexed J-way, minority, multimodal and disagreement geometry

source_state_law.mixed_source_rule: An owner rule must name the exact source set and per-source admissible states. One source cannot silently stand in for another. Disagreement remains dereferenceable geometry; no modal/majority aggregation is implicit.
source_state_law.rule: Every source remains independently typed. NO_GEOMETRY states contribute no geometry. Qualified states may be inspected only if the exact owner rule explicitly admits that state; otherwise that source has zero empirical effect. No state is converted into actor belief/nonbelief or a generic null.

zero_effect_if_any: owning rule has no explicit empirical-use binding
required PSEPF ref/hash cannot be dereferenced exactly
provenance closure or intake causal-parent receipt fails
